name: NxLauncher / Launch Strata
origin: Original hand-authored SVG geometry created for NxLauncher; no generated-image API, stock assets, third-party logos, game artwork, embedded bitmap images or external downloads.
concept: A vivid red lacquer macOS tile carrying warm-white library strata, a rose-white launch portal and a crimson launch well. Individually tuned surface, bevel, inset, reflection and shadow gradients; no hue filter, no decorative holiday motifs, no replica of any console or company mark.
reference: Project home screen's blue stacked-library motif for composition, plus the user's own supplied red rounded-square application icon for the palette and red/white contrast; conceptual inspiration only. Neither reference asset is copied: no control-pill shapes, no circular buttons and no third-party marks appear in this artwork.
requirements: macOS with Swift/AppKit, Python 3 standard library, system iconutil. No pip packages, API keys, network, or separate font downloads required.

outputs.../../Resources/AppIcon.png: 1024 x 1024 RGBA PNG, transparent outside the rounded tile
outputs.../../Resources/AppIcon.icns: Complete 16, 32, 128, 256, 512 point icon family at 1x and 2x; 10 representations spanning 16-1024 pixels
outputs.hero.svg: 1600 x 640 standalone static SVG; inline gradients and original vectors; no scripts, foreignObject, external images, filters, or external font resources
outputs.hero-preview.png: 1600 x 640 local AppKit preview; SVG remains the README asset
outputs.icon-sizes.png: 960 x 640 contact sheet; actual 16, 32, 64, 128, 256 pixel renders on light/dark backgrounds

optical_adjustment: The launch key is enlarged 1.5x at 16px and 1.2x at 32px by render.swift; all other geometry remains shared with the editable SVG master.
typography: hero.svg uses an editable Avenir Next / Avenir / Trebuchet MS / sans-serif fallback stack. Exact text shapes may vary by GitHub viewer's installed fonts; layout reserves room for fallback metrics.
verification: Opened the previous ICNS raster before replacement.
Visually reviewed the 1024px PNG, 1600px hero and light/dark small-size contact sheet.
16/32px optical correction preserves the diamond aperture and warm-white launch key.
Parsed both SVGs as XML and checked they are self-contained.
Decoded ICNS representations and checked their dimensions and alpha.
Warm revision: visually reviewed 1024px icon, 1600px hero and actual 16/32/64/128/256px light/dark previews; verified all 10 ICNS representations and exact 1024px PNG match.

Red revision: reviewed the user-supplied reference icon, then reviewed the 1024px PNG and the actual 16/32/64/128/256px contact sheet on light and dark backgrounds; contact sheet shows the aperture and key stay legible at 16px.
revision: Second warm revision: palette moved to the user's preferred vivid red and warm white, and the strata became light panels over a red tile. Layer/portal composition and the 16/32px optical corrections are retained. Still original geometry; no asset from the reference icon is embedded. No release or version increment.
